## 0f6ba01fa18c

### A-0F-1 — reproduced validator hole; easy-band curriculum restriction

The documented invariant requires one connected color-1 template and one connected color-2 template. The retained input in `checks/audit/0f6ba01fa18c/input.json` contains two disconnected color-1 components, yet `self_check` returns `[]` (`checks/audit/audit-probe.json`). This input therefore **passes the target validator but is outside the documented/default generator domain**.

The live Racket authority consumes a selected color-1 object and returns a 2×1 cyan result (`checks/audit/0f6ba01fa18c/racket.json`). A plausible all-color normalization of every color-1 cell returns a different 3×2 result (`checks/audit/0f6ba01fa18c/rival-output.json`). The supported apply command exited 0; its log is `checks/audit/0f6ba01fa18c/apply-command.log`. This is a concrete validator defect, although the default generator did not produce the malformed scene in the sample.

A separate curriculum question is reproducible within the generated domain: in 200 easy-band draws, key 3 (union) appeared 200/200 times and an always-union shortcut matched 200/200 labels. Medium covered keys 3/4/6 at 62/71/67 and hard covered 4/6 at 97/103, so the shortcut is band-specific rather than task-wide. Evidence: `checks/audit/audit-probe.json` and `checks/audit/probe.py`.

No source change was made to this audit target.

audits.resolution_reason: Validator accepts disconnected color-1 templates outside the documented domain; easy-band union-only curriculum is a separate sampled limitation. Reviewer-reported focused inputs, supported Racket receipt and comparison retained beside this generator.

## 0f6ba01fa18c

**Reproduced validator defect; suspected band-specific shortcut. No source change made.** Generator SHA-256: `405d2408290ceb3e8d9f9d792733d609ce1493622da30ac4a81030d396ca521a`; version `2.2.0`; executed rule hash `a3fbbd340472`.

The documented domain has one connected color-1 template and one connected color-2 template. The retained 8×10 adversarial input has color-1 component sizes 3 and 1, color-2 component size 2, and one union key, yet `self_check` returns `[]`. The input is therefore validator-accepted but outside the ordinary generator domain. The authority takes the first color-1 object and returns a 2×2 cyan square; a natural rival that normalizes all color-1 cells returns a 5×2 result. The supported Racket receipt and exact hashes are in `checks/audit/0f6ba01fa18c/racket.json`; comparison is in `comparison.json`, and the input/rival are retained beside them.

A separate curriculum restriction is within the generated domain: across 200 unique inputs per band, easy used key 3 (union) 200/200 times, while medium used keys 3/4/6 in 69/69/62 draws and hard used 4/6 in 97/103. Thus an always-union rule fits the entire sampled easy band. This is a suspected easy-band teaching shortcut, not evidence of an incorrect authority label or a task-wide shortcut.

Checked: source and summary, canonical rule behavior through supported `arcpuzzles apply`, validator connectivity, 600 generated inputs across three bands, input uniqueness, and control-key coverage. Evidence and reproduction: `checks/audit/0f6ba01fa18c/probe.py`, `probe-report.json`, `apply-command.log`, `racket.json`, and `comparison.json`.

## 0f6ba01fa18c

**Reproduced defects** in generator SHA-256 `405d2408290ceb3e8d9f9d792733d609ce1493622da30ac4a81030d396ca521a`:

1. Lint fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing; it also reports two singleton axes and two unprobed one-token axes. The current canonical hash suggestion is `a3fbbd340472`. Evidence: `checks/audit-0f6-lint/checks/0f6ba01fa18c_after_lint.log`.
2. The advertised override contract is materially false: 9,172 findings across 31,410 draws / 349 cases. A minimized example is difficulty `easy`, seed `0`, override `{"grid_h": 10}`: the declared/default case rejects it because the implementation restricts easy height to `[7, 9]`, despite the public axis advertising larger values. The report also records 9,090 undeclared multi-axis rejections accepted only under legacy compatibility policy. Evidence: `checks/audit-0f6-override/checks/0f6ba01fa18c_after_override_results.json` and `.log`.
3. The required semantic gate fails with `hooks=none`: no `strict_canonical_like`, `SEMANTIC_WITNESSES`, or `lesson_identifiable` contract is declared. Evidence: `checks/audit-0f6-semantic/checks/0f6ba01fa18c_after_semantic_gate.log`.

These findings are audit-only; I did not modify the target.
